title: Flow artifact
description: A reviewable user journey. Machine-readable for agents AND human-readable via summary/human fields. business-analyst derives L2/L3 Gherkin ACs from steps + branches; each step links back to those ACs via `implements`, and impl_status is derived from the ACs' work_status.

level.description: Altitude in the drill-down hierarchy: journey = end-to-end; pipeline = a stage's phase chain; agent = an agent's internal workflow. OPTIONAL.

kind.description: What the flow describes: a user journey, a data pipeline, or an architecture process.

source.description: Whether the flow is a mock/demo journey or a real system process.

summary.description: HUMAN: one-paragraph plain-language description of the whole journey.

status.description: Lifecycle: is this journey live or retired.

readiness.description: Review state: has a persona approved it yet.

superseded_by.description: id of the artifact replacing this one when status=deprecated.

mock_data_ref.description: id of the Mock Data artifact populating this flow.

human.description: HUMAN: one-line 'what the user is doing/seeing' on this step.

screen.description: mockup id this step renders, if any.

agent.description: The actor that runs this step — an agent id (config/agent_registry.json) or a script/workflow name. The subject of the handoff.

produces.description: Named data artifacts/fields this step hands DOWNSTREAM (the output side of the agent→agent handoff contract), e.g. 'Ticket.test_requirements', 'red_baseline'.

consumes.description: Named data artifacts/fields this step requires from UPSTREAM (the input side of the handoff contract). A consumes value with no matching upstream produces is a broken handoff.

implements.description: AC ids (docs/acceptance-criteria/) derived from this step's acceptance_scenarios. AUTHORED link — the source of truth for graph↔AC linkage.

expands_to.description: id of the child flow this step drills into (C4-style sub-flow). When set, this step's impl_status is DERIVED from the child flow's rollup, taking precedence over `implements`. OPTIONAL.

impl_status.description: DERIVED from work_status of every AC in `implements`, OR (when `expands_to` is set) from the child flow's rollup. Regenerated by the impl-status generator; never hand-edited.

agent.description: The actor that runs this branch — an agent id or a script/workflow name.

produces.description: Named data artifacts/fields this branch hands downstream (output side of the handoff contract).

consumes.description: Named data artifacts/fields this branch requires from upstream (input side of the handoff contract).

impl_summary.description: DERIVED rollup across steps + branches, for the visualizer to badge the whole journey.

acceptance_scenarios.description: Given/When/Then seeds the business-analyst turns into L2/L3 ACs. Double as human documentation.

for.description: id of the step OR branch this scenario covers (steps + branches share one id namespace).
